data.name: Death Becomes Her Funeral Limo Tour of Los Angeles
data.headline: A two-hour guided limo tour of Los Angeles’ most notorious true crime, scandal and paranormal sites.
data.description: Sink into a custom funeral limo and glide through Hollywood, West Hollywood, and Beverly Hills while a storyteller threads together scandals, murders, overdoses, and paranormal lore. This atmospheric two-hour ride blends true crime history with noir-style narration, curated audio, and visual background materials to make each stop feel cinematic. From infamous hotels and crime scenes to celebrity mansions and haunted landmarks, the tour reveals the darker stories behind glamour and neon, turning familiar streets into a riveting moving crime scene.
data.highlights:
* Ride in a custom funeral limo with atmospheric lighting and curated audio
* Expert storytelling that brings victims, killers, and scandals vividly to life
* Visit an extensive list of iconic and notorious Los Angeles true crime and paranormal sites
* Immersive visual gallery accessible via cell phone data during the tour
data.itinerary:
1. Highland Gardens Hotel (Janis Joplin overdose site)
2. Sunset Grove double homicide and beheading
3. North Orange Grove Avenue ("Halloween" movie houses)
4. Former Ed Buck apartment
5. Barney's Beanery
6. West Hollywood condo murder (Blake Leibel case)
7. Beverly Hills jewelry heist site
8. Spadena House (Witch's House)
9. Howard Hughes plane crash site on Linden Drive
10. Bugsy Siegel murder site at 810 North Linden Drive
11. Beverly Hills Bermuda Triangle on Whittier Drive
12. Michael Jackson's Carolwood Drive home
13. Lana Turner/Johnny Stompanato site on North Bedford Drive
14. Menendez Mansion on North Elm Drive
15. Greystone Mansion murder-suicide site
16. Viper Room (River Phoenix overdose site)
17. Brittany Murphy's final Hollywood Hills home
18. Sunset Tower hauntings
19. Chateau Marmont scandals
20. Sunset Strip (Sunset Slayers story)

data.cancellation_summary: Tours may be canceled for low bookings; no refund for late arrivals; refunds only if operator cancels or in specific circumstances described by operator.
data.cancellation_notes: We offer a 100% refund for customers that contact us at least 24 hours in advance of their scheduled departure. Cancellations with fewer than 24 hours notice will not be issued a refund.  No shows including those that arrive late for their departure time will be charged 100% without rescheduling option. (Hey! Allow PLENTY of time to get to your meeting spot!)
data.booking_notes:
It is the sad duty of Grave Line Tours to announce the tragic passing of certain magnificent individuals, precious few of whom died peacefully at their home. A private memorial service will be held inside of a beautifully melancholic restored vintage Cadillac funeral limousine. Tissues will be on hand in case of bouts of severe sadness.  

The service commences strictly on schedule. 
Once more, the service starts on time. 
Therefore, please keep in mind that the service starts on schedule, as the dead wait for no one.

Loved ones, acquaintances and mourners shall gather at the Ovation Center, 6801 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles 90028 at Hollywood and Highland. If you park in Ovation, take the elevator to level 2. If you’re walking in from Hollywood Blvd, please ascend the unnaturally wide steps opposite the El Capitan Theater. Or, from Highland, up the staircase near the light at Yucca.  Once in the level 2 courtyard, look for your guide on the side of the “Pandora” store, by the entry to the grand courtyard.

For more information and photos of the meeting point, kindly please visit https://graveline.rip/pages/tour-info. 

There is ample parking in the dark labyrinth known as a “garage” underneath the Ovation Hollywood center. For information on directions and parking rates, please inspect their site directly. Grave Line Tours does not validate as of now, but there are several frighteningly wondrous shops, theaters and eateries you may find yourself looking to donate to before or after your ride, in the name of the departed and cheaper parking. Please do not bring food or drink (apart from bottled water, holy is fine too) into the vehicle. 

A mortuary associate will be present at the meeting point to welcome your presence twenty minutes prior to taking your seats in the service.  We strongly advise you to allow PLENTY of time to find parking and make the journey from there up to the meeting point. Los Angeles is big and traffic can be really bad here, and— like all tragic occurences, is almost always worse than you even plan for.  

Therefore we urge you as strongly as mortally possible to arrive at the MEETING POINT (not parking structure) 15-20 MINUTES **before** your service is set to depart. It is unfortunately impossible to disrupt the service with a call once the tour has begun.  (Texting us to let us know you're running late does not change anything.) So please, lovely Grave Line mourner, be forewarned: there is simply no way to join the memorial service other than on time at the initial congregating spot.  

Look for a friendly woman! In the event you do not find your guide to the service, please call Blaze at (310) 621-3023. International mourners can Whatsapp her at +1 310 621-3023.

Did we mention you will need to allow PLENTY of time because of Los Angeles traffic and unforeseen circumstances?  Heed our Warning, and don’t miss your chance to bid farewell to souls departed!

In lieu of flowers please bring your fondest memories of the decedents to share. Thank you.
data.check_in_details: Meet at Ovation Hollywood (6801 Hollywood Blvd). A mortuary associate will welcome guests at the meeting point 20 minutes before boarding; arrive 15–20 minutes early at the meeting point. Tours depart on time and late arrivals cannot join or be rescheduled.
data.accessibility: Vehicles are older limousines that may not meet modern accessibility standards; limited accommodation for mobility devices.
data.special_requirements: Tours contain graphic descriptions and explicit images; not recommended for children under 12. Individuals under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
data.restrictions: No luggage or strollers may be accommodated. No eating, smoking or drinking on tours (bottled water with caps allowed). Pets and infants under age 5 are prohibited.
data.health_and_safety_notes:
Tours are not for all audiences! 

Content is often extreme and graphic in nature and every passenger will have access to explicit photos of crime scenes and autopsies. 

Parental guidance is highly recommended for passengers under the age of 18.
data.disclaimers: Operator may cancel tours for low bookings. Tours operate regardless of weather unless safety is at risk; tours leave as scheduled and late arrivals will not be reimbursed. Vehicles are older thirty-year-old limousines and may have wear-and-tear; operator is not liable for certain damages or events beyond its control. In the event of a breakdown, operator will return passengers to the departure point and issue a full refund of the ticket cost. Passengers may be asked to reschedule or refunded if vehicle capacity, weight, or safety concerns arise.
